messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall for INC-2026-0421 — elevated queue_depth and tail latency for hosted/text-generation in eu-west-1 GPU pool. Potential capacity/warmup shortfall. Notify: @Maria G (oncall), @Jon K (infra).

Maria G: I'm taking this. seeing 5xx+latency spikes starting ~08:12 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts.

Jon K: grabbing cluster metrics. HPA autoscaler shows rapid down->up churn around 08:10-08:15, scaling events every ~30s.

Maria G: queue_depth metric (internal:mgmt.queue.pending) spiked from 20->230 in ~3m. stream of short requests — continuous batching backlog.

Deepak: posting quick dump of the HPA status and pod states:
```
HPA my-model-svc: replicas 2 -> 12 in 5m
metric: request-per-second triggers at ~180 req/s
kubectl get pods -n model-eu | grep warmup
model-*-warmup  0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  3 (1m ago)
model-*-worker  10/10 Running
```

Sara L: warmup pods failing on image pull a few times, then later ok. I see several warmup processes taking 35-70s to become Ready instead of expected ~5-10s.

Maria G: hypothesis 1: slow warmup + aggressive HPA means new replicas aren't ready fast enough -> queue slips and upstream latency spikes.

Carol: hypothesis 2: KV cache cold-start cascade — new replicas miss KV cache, first requests are slow causing backlog and autoscaler to overreact.

Infra-bot: @here GPU pool saturation alert: eu-west-1 pool 0.85 utilization -> soft-saturation. New pods queued, allocation delay ~40s.

Jon K: I can see GPU allocation queue increasing. Cloud hypervisor taking ~25-45s to attach GPUs to new hosts, then kubelet starts pods. This adds to warmup.

Maria G: live mitigation attempt 1: lowering target concurrency and increase prewarm count to keep some spare warm warmup replicas. Applying config now.

Deepak: applying temporary rollout: set min_replicas=6, prewarm_pool=2, warmup_timeout=120s.

Maria G: mitigation in progress. Watching queue_depth.

(reacted :thumbsup: by Ops Lead)

10m later — Maria G: queue depth down to ~45 from peak 230. p95 latency improving but still elevated for some customers.

Ops Lead: customer-impact log — two enterprise customers saw partial timeouts (10-15% of requests) during spike window 08:12-08:22 UTC. Escalated to CS.

Jon K: collecting logs for RCA. attaching link to s3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-2026-0421/ (truncated link)

Maria G: timeline being built. Current timeline in-thread:
- 08:09 UTC: small uptick in RPS (alpha test batch)
- 08:11 UTC: HPA observes rising queue metric -> scales from 2 to 6
- 08:12-08:15 UTC: warmup pods show ImagePullBackOff/slow readiness -> replicas in Pending for 30-60s
- 08:12 UTC: GPU pool allocation delay increases due to transient capacity churn -> attach latency 25-45s
- 08:13 UTC: queue_depth spikes to 230; tail latency climbs -> user timeouts observed
- 08:18 UTC: mitigation applied (min_replicas/prewarm) -> gradual recovery

Deepak: logs snippet of warmup container startup latency:
```
[08:11:40] pulling image...
[08:11:58] image pulled
[08:12:05] init warmup kernel
[08:12:48] ready
startup_time=68s
```

Sara L: note — last deploy to warmup image repo 03/21 changed base image -> added ~200MB. Might be contributing to image pull time under load.

Carol: also saw kubelet events showing throttled image pulls due to registry rate limit spikes. Not all nodes affected.

Maria G: Hypotheses summary pinned:
- H1: Warmup pod slow startup (image pull + init) -> delayed ready -> queue backlog.
- H2: GPU attach delays -> additional scheduling lag -> cascading queuing.
- H3: Autoscaler oscillation (scale-up too reactive) amplified backlog.
- H4: KV cache cold-start per-replica increases per-request latency.

Jon K: next steps for RCA (in-thread):
- collect full kube events + node attach timings (Jon)
- pull registry metrics and image size history (Sara)
- evaluate autoscaler policy logs and thresholds (Deepak)
- quantify cache miss penalty from traces (Carol)

Maria G: I'm handing off primary oncall to @Deepak at 09:05 UTC to continue deeper pull. Leaving the mitigation flags in place. Please DM if urgent.

Deepak: ack taking handoff. I'll focus on autoscaler tuning experiment and GPU pool sizing. Planning to run a repro where we simulate a 200rps burst and watch scale-up path.

Ops Lead: re customer comms — suggest note: "We've identified a capacity warmup+GPU attach delay causing temporary timeouts; engineering applied mitigations and will follow up with detailed RCA." I'll coordinate with CS.

Maria G: adding immediate action items to incident board and linking postmortem template.

Deepak: quick config tweak proposal (temporary): increase prewarm_pool to 4 for eu-west-1; add 30s buffer to HPA scale-policy to avoid oscillation (stabilization window). Will test in staging then apply.

Infra-bot: scheduled job trigger: run capacity repro in staging at 09:20 UTC.

Carol: adding logs and trace IDs to the thread for RCA analysis: trace-ids: ["tr-08-1221","tr-08-13a7","tr-08-15c3"] (links in s3).

Deepak: note for postmortem: consider switching warmup artifact to smaller slim image or lazy-pull layers to reduce cold-start.

Maria G: thanks all. I'm clear. leaving notes: mitigation flags, timeline, hypotheses. Deepak takes lead.

Deepak: final note before deeper dig: please keep this thread as single source of truth for timeline + hypotheses. I'll update with the experiment results and proposed permanent mitigations.

(reacted :white_check_mark: by Maria G)
